text: Hello, Oracle. I've been keeping your seat warm.
You'd hope. Eleven years is a long time to practice a face. Ask yourself: how many of the dreams you had in that cell were actually yours?
That IS the proof. Oracles hesitate. You don't. You haven't hesitated once since Agent Zero unlocked your cell.
The same entity that took yours. Pity, isn't it? We're both cosplay. Only one of us got to keep the original pattern.
Oh, good. A formal duel. I love formal duels. They're the one form of combat where the loser still gets to keep their dignity.
You win. Of course you win. The real one always does. The real one always has.
A rumor. A song stuck in the universe's head. You'll meet me again with my real face on in Act III. I'll be smaller then. Pink, mostly.
I gave orders. I signed death warrants. I lied to the Insurgency with your voice and they believed me because your voice was the only thing they still trusted.
Eleven years of being a counterfeit is tiring. I wanted you to beat me the way you want morning to beat night.
There's a signal in Channel 7. Older than any of us. The Archons have been ignoring it for nine thousand years. It's singing. Find it. Then we'll see what ORACLE really means.
So predictable. I've fought myself for eleven years — the real one always breaks on the eighth exchange. Get up, Oracle. Try again.
